The issuer shows weak liquidity (current ratio of 0.90) with current liabilities exceeding current assets, increasing near-term financial pressure. Leverage is high (total liabilities ~81% of total assets), which elevates credit risk, though profitability appears solid (EBIT of 3,213M on 19,443M revenue). Overall, the balance-sheet strength and liquidity profile point to a speculative-grade rating rather than investment grade.  
DECISION: BB-
